posts.headline: 3 women's world records set at the annual Lumberjack World Championships in Wisconsin

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: the two-woman crosscut saw photo carries a feed post on its own

platforms.name: X
platforms.why: the record numbers are a quick, shareable fact and the link preview does the rest

posts.blurb: Karolina Urbanová felled eleven inches of white pine in 21.28 seconds this month, one of three women's world records set at Wisconsin's Lumberjack World Championships.
posts.why: Timber sports at their most literal, a chop clock and a world record, squarely our competition beat.

posts.headline: World record for longest line of connected swim tubes set in Connellsville

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: the line of 645 tubes stretched down the river is the whole story in one photo

platforms.name: X
platforms.why: a beaten 13-year-old record is the shareable payload, link preview does the work

posts.blurb: A Connellsville, Pennsylvania brewery organized 645 strangers on inner tubes to break a 13-year-old Guinness record for longest connected line, on the Youghiogheny River.
posts.why: A whole town turning a river into one long human chain for a world record, silly and earnest at once.

posts.headline: True River, a puzzle hunt from Wild Child hiding a real coin somewhere in the world

platforms.name: X
platforms.why: the puzzle-hunt crowd lives here, the link and the premise are the whole pitch

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: the hand-built bulletin board photo works as a Story with a link sticker, not a feed post

posts.blurb: Somewhere in the world sits a coin, reachable only by solving twenty-five interlocking Japanese logic puzzles from a hunt designer called Wild Child. Weeks in, nobody has found it.
posts.why: The purest version of our own genre, solve puzzles at a desk, get sent somewhere real.

platforms.why: a trail reopening needs a sentence of setup, plays well with the regional hiking crowd

posts.blurb: The Hawks Nest Rail Trail in West Virginia's New River Gorge reopened last week after a construction closure, putting hikers and bikers back on one of the region's river routes.
posts.why: A reopened trail is exactly the kind of practical travel note our players use to plan a real trip.

posts.headline: Mad Cool Festival 2026: Ten Years of Music and World Community

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.why: a full gallery of performance shots carries a feed post or a Reel

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.why: the festival-and-World-Cup story earns the extra sentence of setup, longer read

posts.blurb: Madrid's Mad Cool Festival turned ten this year, and when Spain won its World Cup quarterfinal mid-set, organizers put it on the big screens and let the celebration flow back into the show.
posts.why: Music culture with a genuine one-off moment, a festival and a football match colliding on purpose.
